  | notes                    = The wand created from recipe 1/20 casts the spell Ray of Frost at caster level 1. Recipe 2/20 can be used up to four times to upgrade this item's caster level and enhancement bonus by 1 each upgrade, up to a maximum of caster level 5 and enhancement bonus +8 ({{Popup|as shown here.|[[File:Item +5 Eternal Wand of Ray of Frost.png|center]]|long=yes}}) ''This wand has been upgraded twice.''

The wand is not bound when created, but is automatically [[Bind#Binds_on_Equip_(BoE)|bound to character when equipped]], so it can be mailed, traded, or auctioned. The wand is [[Exclusive]]; you can only have 1 in your inventory. Attempting to create a 2nd while the first is still in your inventory will fail with an error message, but not consume any ingredients.

The spell's full damage description is stated as "1d3 +1 per caster level (max 5)." The 5 refers to the maximum caster level bonus. Maxing out the caster level through multiple recipe 2/20 transmutations will result in a max hit of 8. 

As with any wand, this damage can be further improved by [[enhancement]]s. For example, [[Archmage_enhancements#Tier_One|Tier 1 Archmage]] Wand and Scroll Mastery I gives a 25% effectiveness bonus to the wand, resulting in a max hit of 10 (125% x 8), etc.

''As of the 2013 games, the Glaciation Recipes can no longer be applied to this item.''
